note_tweet.text:
The claim by TMC and Left handles that "police were absent" at Chorbagan is complete propaganda.
Anyone on the ground knows police were deployed throughout. You cannot assign a personal officer to every visitor. They just spreading this rumour because they're rattled because their anti-hindu book stalls is getting demolished because they didn't bothered to apply for the permission!!

What actually went wrong:

• Sudden heavy rain forced a massive crowd to bottleneck at the narrow exit.
• A volunteer announced that the pandal might collapse—whether out of panic to clear space or negligence is subject to investigation.
• That announcement triggered absolute panic in an already suffocating, dark exit.

Blaming the police ignores how reckless crowd-hyping and rumor-mongering turned a weather bottleneck into chaos.

The dangerous trend of artificial crowd-bottlenecking to hype up pandals—popularized by clubs like Sreebhumi—combined with reckless rumors is what caused this, not police absence.
Video by : @ANI

Over the years, major incidents and casualties reported during Durga Puja celebrations in West Bengal include:
October 2026 (Kolkata): A stampede at the Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal killed at least 19 people (mostly women and children) and injured 25 others after sudden rainfall triggered a massive crowd surge near the exit gates. 
October 2024 (Kolkata & Bhangar): 7 people died and 22 were injured in 19 road accidents reported across Kolkata and Bhangar during the festival (October 9–13), with motorcycles involved in 16 of the crashes. 
Prior Overcrowding & Safety Incidents: Severe crowd management scares and near-stampedes occurred in past years at high-profile pandals such as Deshapriya Park, Sreebhumi, and Kalyani, prompting temporary administrative closures.

No, not all. After the Chorbagan stampede that killed 19 on Saturday, police temporarily restricted entry at several major crowd-pulling pandals (like Tala Pratyay, Chetla Agrani, Alipore Sarbojanin and some in Bidhannagar/Salt Lake) to manage rushes. No citywide shutdown. Belur Math is a monastic site, Sovabazar Rajbari a traditional household puja—neither specifically listed as closed. Shah postponed his planned visits there to meet the injured instead.
